# 达尔文算法知识图谱

## 图 1：达尔文算法概览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A1["Darwin Algorithm (named after evolution)"]
    A2["Developed by Korean team, paper noted on HuggingFace"]
    A3["No distillation or fine‑tuning required"]
    A4["Hybrid of two models: parent (distilled) and child (original)"]
    A5["Resulting model C stronger than both parents"]
    A6["Goal: combine knowledge breadth and reasoning depth"]

    A1 --> A2
    A1 --> A3
    A3 --> A4
    A4 --> A5
    A5 --> A6
```
关键结论时间戳：  
- 算法命名与来源 [00:21‑00:31]  
- 韩国团队与论文关注 [00:31‑00:39]  
- 不使用蒸馏或微调 [01:03‑01:04]  
- 两模型杂交 [01:07‑01:10]  
- 产出模型 C 超越 A、B [01:17‑01:26]  
- 兼顾知识广度与推理深度 [01:20‑01:27]

## 图 2：模型结构与蒸馏影响
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    B1["Attention layer (routing)"]
    B2["FFN (knowledge store)"]
    B3["Distillation refines FFN for reasoning"]
    B4["Attention layer must remain unchanged"]
    B5["Distillation narrows knowledge retrieval (bookshelf analogy)"]
    B6["Hybrid restores original knowledge breadth"]

    B1 --> B4
    B2 --> B3
    B3 --> B5
    B5 --> B6
    B2 --> B6
```
关键结论时间戳：  
- Attention 层负责路由 [04:37‑04:43]  
- FFN 存储知识 [04:23‑04:31]  
- 蒸馏改进 FFN 推理能力 [04:53‑05:33]  
- Attention 层不可改动 [04:48‑04:51]  
- 蒸馏导致检索范围收窄 [06:21‑06:33]  
- 杂交恢复知识广度 [06:45‑07:18]

## 图 3：达尔文模型系列与版本
```mermaid
flowchart LR
    C1["Darwin 28B (27B + 1B Opus)"]
    C2["Opus (distilled base) → enhances reasoning"]
    C3["Original 27B → provides knowledge breadth"]
    C4["Darwin 28B Reason (extra distillation)"]
    C5["Reason uses R7D (Reason trees distillation)"]
    C6["Darwin 36B Oplus (original + 36B)"]
    C7["Darwin 31B (V6) vs V7 latest"]
    C8["V7 version offers better performance"]

    C1 --> C2
    C1 --> C3
    C1 --> C4
    C4 --> C5
    C6 --> C1
    C7 --> C8
```
关键结论时间戳：
